benchmark.manifest: research/fastlane/vendor/BENCHMARK_SOURCE.json (lineage, series SPY, return_type TOTAL_RETURN, vendor_id, dataset, fallback NONE)
benchmark.rule: the exact vendor dataset is recorded in the committed manifest before any grant; no other source may substitute
benchmark.series: SPY total return (dividends reinvested) from the licensed vendor

capacity.rule: same constructor at each multiple with the 0.1% ADV20 cap; net annualized alpha reported at each

census_binding.grant_time_check: require_outcome_access recomputes the sha256 of events_relpath and refuses on mismatch
census_binding.grid_selection_disclosure: the variant grid and its adequacy screen were chosen from outcome-blind event COUNTS that include holdout-period (2021-07..2026-06) counts; no outcome of any split was read

constructor.allocation: a_j = min(C0/slots, participation_cap_adv20 * ADV20_j); ADV20 = mean of raw_close*raw_volume over the 20 completed vendor sessions before entry; ADV20 below frictions.untradeable_adv20_below_usd -> skipped (counted)
constructor.no_recycling: realized P&L is not recycled into C0
constructor.order: entries are processed by (entry_session, tie_break); the lowest free slot is taken; an issuer with an active slot or a full book gets a_j = 0 (reason logged)
constructor.slot_release: time-based at the scheduled exit close; never early on gain, loss or delisting
constructor.tie_break: sha256(utf8(str(inference.bootstrap_seed) + '|' + ','.join(sorted(accessions of the issuer-day)))) ascending hex (quant.fastlane.constructor.tie_break_key); never issuer CIK

classes.CASH_ACQUISITION: last traded price, no extra loss

delisting.mapping_manifest: research/fastlane/vendor/DELISTING_CLASS_MAP.json (vendor code -> class) with derivation VENDOR_DOCUMENTATION_ONLY and source {documentation_url, retrieved_on}; committed AND pushed before ANY outcome grant in any split (enforced by require_outcome_access)

execution.missing_entry_bar: no vendor bar at the entry session -> no fill; the event is skipped and counted
execution.missing_exit_bar: no bar at the scheduled exit -> exit at the next available open; if none within 20 sessions, apply the delisting treatment from the last traded price

firewall.frozen_lineage: no read/write of FORM4_FIRST_VERTICAL_MULTI_COHORT_V1; its cohorts are prospective and were never activated, so the 2006-2026H1 fast-lane population cannot overlap them
firewall.outcome_access: only via require_outcome_access: complete (non-shallow) clone; seal reloaded and git-anchored (one commit ever touches it, ancestor of HEAD, ancestor of a branch tip advertised by `git ls-remote origin` - local refs/remotes never count - bytes equal); vendor manifests anchored the same way; event table sha equal to census_binding; holdout via the committed write-once HOLDOUT_REQUEST.json which pins the seal commit (var/ ledger is a cache); grants are HMAC-tokenized and re-verified, including the git anchor, on every vendor call

impact.volatility: stdev of daily log close-to-close over the 20 sessions before the leg

frictions.provenance: frozen from literature/engineering choices; NOT calibrated on the data being evaluated

spread.effective: max(Abdi-Ranaldo estimate over the 21 sessions before the leg, ADV20-bucket full-spread floor); cost per side = half of it

stress.rule: all friction costs x2, reported alongside; never part of GO

all_of: annualized net alpha vs SPY >= 3%/yr at 1x C0 (base delisting)
Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 for BOTH the studentized block bootstrap and the fixed-b HAC co-check
net result positive at 1x C0 after frictions
vendor attestation go_eligible (includes delisted, PIT mapping, raw prices plus actions, verified)
go_criterion.authority_if_go: SHADOW_PROVISIONAL paper only (D6 caps); never FORWARD_CONFIRMATION or real capital

governance.branch_protection: OWNER ACTION: protect the fast-lane branch on the remote (no force-push, no deletion) before the seal is pushed
governance.external_anchor: OWNER ACTION: record the seal commit hash and, later, the holdout request commit hash outside the repository (e.g. a dated message or note held by the owner) as soon as each is pushed; a later grant whose anchors differ from these records is void
governance.residual_risk: code cannot prevent a force-push or branch deletion by someone with remote write access; it detects a rewrite of the seal commit (the request pins it and every grant re-checks it against the advertised tip) but a rewrite of only the request commit that keeps the seal commit is detectable only through the external anchor and branch protection

co_check.purpose: valid with few effective 80-session blocks (~15 in the holdout)
co_check.test: fixed-b HAC t-test of mean r_ex, one-sided

inference.go_requires: BOTH the bootstrap and the fixed-b HAC p-values below the Holm threshold
inference.primary_test: one-sided studentized moving-block bootstrap of mean r_ex (H1: > 0)

seed_robustness.role: REPORTING ONLY: the verdict statistics (bootstrap p-values, CI bounds, admitted sets) recomputed under seeds seed+1..seed+5 are published alongside; they never change the verdict

inference.unit: daily net r_ex,t of the calendar-time portfolio (return_object)

multiplicity.discovery: DSR ranking; Romano-Wolf stepdown (Hansen SPA as cross-check) on net r_ex
multiplicity.dsr: Deflated Sharpe on discovery with N = N_trials
multiplicity.finalist_rule: top <=3 by discovery DSR among variants with Romano-Wolf p<0.10 and positive walk-forward net annualized alpha; finalists must have discovery and walk-forward trial-ledger records
multiplicity.holdout: Holm at family alpha 0.05 over the finalists, applied to both tests
multiplicity.n_trials_context: N_trials is the multiplicity count for DSR and the Holm context; it is recorded in the committed holdout request
multiplicity.screening_rule: before a holdout request is accepted, ALL M_declared variants must have discovery trial-ledger records (not only finalists)
multiplicity.trial_ledger: var/fastlane/ledgers/trials.jsonl (hash-chained); every evaluated variant appended; its head is stored in the committed holdout request

outcomes.inconclusive: GO fails but the one-sided 95% upper bound is >= 3%/yr; logged distinctly from NO_GO
outcomes.no_go: GO fails and the one-sided 95% upper bound of net annualized alpha is < 3%/yr; recorded as a result
outcomes.sizing: neither NO_GO nor INCONCLUSIVE authorizes any sizing

population.backdating_exclusion: accession sequence year > FILING_DATE year -> excluded; residual risk: same-year backdating is undetectable in the data sets
population.dedupe: exact duplicates dropped first-seen by (FILING_DATE, accession) on (issuer, sorted owner CIKs, sorted (trans_date, shares, per-share figure))
population.document_type: original Form 4 only ('4'); 4/A never creates or modifies an event

footnote_exclusion_regex.plan_drip_fees: dividend reinvestment|\bdrip\b|employee stock purchase|\bespp\b|401\(k\)|deferred compensation|in lieu of (cash )?(director|board|fees|compensation|salary)|director'?s'? fee
footnote_exclusion_regex.private_placement: private placement|privately negotiated|subscription agreement|securities purchase agreement|accredited investor

population.footnote_rule: a row is excluded if a footnote attached to its security title or a transaction field, or the filing REMARKS, matches a category (case-insensitive); holdings/ownership footnotes are never scanned
population.roles: relationship flags only; CEO/CFO requires the Officer flag plus a CEO/CFO title; titles never promote a role
population.security_title_include_explicit_regex: \bCOMMON UNITS?\b|\bSHARES OF BENEFICIAL INTEREST\b|^CLASS [A-Z] (COMMON )?(STOCK|SHARES)$|\bORDINARY SHARES?\b|^SHARES$|^CAPITAL STOCK$
population.security_title_rule: upper-cased, whitespace-collapsed title must re.search the include or the explicit-include regex (COMMON UNITS, SHARES OF BENEFICIAL INTEREST, CLASS X [COMMON] STOCK/SHARES, ORDINARY SHARES, bare SHARES / CAPITAL STOCK) and must not re.search the exclude regex, whose UNIT(S) token is waived for COMMON UNIT(S); frozen from title counts only
population.source: SEC Insider Transactions Data Sets (quarterly, 2006Q1 onward), as filed
population.unfiltered_role: the population before title/footnote/dedupe filters is reported as sensitivity only and never enters GO

power.reading: per-event MDE is per trade at horizon h; portfolio MDE is annualized on invested capital including 8 %/yr tracking error vs SPY and is the relevant scale for the 3 %/yr GO bar; the significance legs, not the 3 % leg, bind

protocol.purge: in discovery and walk_forward, events whose scheduled exit session falls after the split end are excluded from that split (logged); discovery and walk-forward price windows end at their split ends, so no holdout-period price is reachable before the one look

return_object.annualized_alpha: 252 x arithmetic mean of r_ex,t over the split's sessions with at least one open position
return_object.formula: r_ex,t = sum_i w_{i,t-1} (r_{i,t} - r_SPY,t) / sum_i w_{i,t-1}
return_object.idle_cash: earns 0 %; reported separately as utilization; cash drag is never counted as alpha
return_object.net: r_{i,t} net of the frozen frictions at 1x C0 (entry/exit legs booked on their sessions); stress 2x reported
return_object.weights: buy-and-hold weights on INVESTED capital: w_i starts at the entry notional a_j and drifts with the position's value; no daily rebalancing

ff5_umd_files: Kenneth R. French Data Library: F-F_Momentum_Factor_daily_CSV.zip
robustness.snapshot: downloaded once, sha256 recorded in a committed manifest before the look

security_mapping.ambiguous: multiple common share classes or no mapping -> unresolved, counted, never resolved with future prices or current tickers
security_mapping.rule: issuer CIK -> vendor security as of the entry date (vendor PIT tickers table with CIK); as-filed ticker is a cross-check only
security_mapping.window: mapping validity is clipped to the grant's price window

discovery.role: screen and rank all declared variants

walk_forward.role: out-of-sample check of the discovery ranking; no re-tuning

timing.calendar: the licensed price vendor's session list; none is invented
timing.entry: open of the first vendor session strictly after available_after_date
timing.transaction_date: never used as a public date

universe_eligibility.bars: 20 complete vendor bars before entry; finite positive ADV20

variant_grid_rule.census_caveat: census counts precede security mapping and liquidity eligibility; eligible counts will be lower

families.CEO_CFO: issuer-day value of primary accessions with >=1 CEO/CFO owner
families.FROZEN_FV_10S: sum of O/D accession values in the 10-session formation window at the crossing; census counts use the weekday proxy, evaluation uses exact vendor sessions and literal distinct CIKs (D07 2.1)
families.OD: issuer-day value of primary accessions with >=1 officer/director owner

variant_grid_rule.literal_frozen_cell: FROZEN_FV_10S_V0_H20 (no value floor, 20-session hold) added as the literal D07 cell
variant_grid_rule.post_eligibility_recheck: after the discovery/walk-forward grants and before any return is computed, PIT mapping and pre-entry eligibility are applied to DISCOVERY AND WALK-FORWARD events only; a variant whose eligible counts then fail the adequacy rule is dropped and logged, never replaced; holdout eligibility is not inspected before the look
